title: How his father trained for the ministry
summary: Thompson does not know the details but says his father worked many jobs, taught school and then entered the ministry.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, dear. You know, there's one thing I wanted to ask you. Where and when did your father get the training in the ministry, in the Methodist Church. That was

Yes, it was. As I said, I don't know all these details, but as I said tonight I will talk to my sister and try to get some more actual facts of dates and so forth. Because I don't know. And I don't know whether they know that or not, but my father, as I said, primarily worked hard. He did many jobs. He's talked about how he had a horse and buggy. He did all kinds of things to make a living that was legal, to put himself through school. And in the process, as I said, he first was a school teacher, so that that primarily would be the fundamental background that you would need.

And the other process would be just an idea of making it known that you wanted to become a minister, and then whatever the process of getting into the church was necessary he evidently did that. Because he was regarded as a very, very efficient minister.
